# routeros_iot_mqtt_subscriptions (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `broker` (String) Name of the broker from `/iot/mqtt/brokers` to subscribe on.
- `topic` (String) Topic filter to subscribe to. The MQTT wildcards `+` and `#` are supported.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `on_message` (String) Script source executed every time a message arrives on the subscribed topic. The variables `$msgData` and `$msgTopic` are available inside the script.
- `qos` (Number) Quality of Service level requested for the subscription. MQTT defines `0`, `1` and `2`; default `0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
